content.title: What time does ‘The Madison’ come on tonight? Streaming info for episodes 4, 5, and 6
content.text: Updated: Mar. 21, 2026, 1:01 p.m.Published: Mar. 21, 2026, 1:01 p.m.The Madison on Paramount PlusThe Madison on Paramount PlusIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.“The Madison“ season one is already fully available on Paramount+. Every single episode of the first season has been released. This is the latest Taylor Sheridan creation, and another spinoff in the “Yellowstone” universe.If you’re looking to watch season one of what is almost certain to be a hit show, there’s only one way to watch it. Here’s a look at the trailer for the series:“The Madison” season one schedule, time & datesThe final three episodes of “The Madison” season one air today, Saturday, March 21, at 12 a.m. PT, 3 a.m. ET on Paramount+. You can the streaming service directly on Paramount+’s website or through Amazon Prime Video. Paramount+ costs $7.99/month or $120 for the year. Or, if you’re a Walmart+ member, you can get a Paramount+ Essential subscription for free (included in your membership).How many episodes are in season 1 of “The Madison”?The first season of “The Madison” has 6 episodes.The season one full schedule is:Episode 1: Pilot – March 14Episode 2: “Let the Land Hold Me” – March 14Episode 3: “Watch Me Fall” – March 14Episode 4: “Tomorrow is Goodbye” - March 21Episode 5: “No Name and a New Dream” - March 21Episode 6: “I Give Me Permission” - March 21“The Madison” Cast ListThis season’s cast of “The Madison” includes a ton of recognizable names and faces.The show’s cast members include:Michelle Pfeiffer as Stacy ClyburnKurt Russell as Preston ClyburnPatrick J. Adams as Russell McIntoshElle Chapman as Paige McIntoshMatthew Fox as Paul ClyburnBeau Garrett as Abigail ReeseAmiah Miller as Bridgette ReeseBen Schnetzer as Van DavisKevin Zegers as Cade HarrisRebecca Spence as Liliana WeeksCan you watch “The Madison” without Paramount+?Generally, no. “The Madison” is a Paramount+ original series.
